scenarios.title: Healthy generic OIDC (JwtBearer)
scenarios.diagnosticSummary: Authority and audience configured; OpenID discovery document reachable.

scenarios.title: OIDC discovery unreachable
scenarios.diagnosticSummary: Discovery document request failed — verify outbound HTTPS and issuer URL.

scenarios.title: Missing audience configuration
scenarios.diagnosticSummary: ArchLucidAuth:Audience is empty — access tokens will fail validation.

scenarios.title: SAML enabled but IdP metadata missing
scenarios.diagnosticSummary: SAML SP enabled but IdP metadata URL is not configured.

scenarios.title: SAML role claim not mapped
scenarios.diagnosticSummary: No SAML role claim sources configured — operators may receive zero ArchLucid roles.
